# create

Create a new Dataverse relationship

## Usage

```
ppds relationship create [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--cascade-assign` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Cascade behavior for assign: Cascade, Active, NoCascade, UserOwned |
| `--cascade-delete` |  | `CascadeBehavior?` |  | Cascade behavior for delete: Cascade, Active, NoCascade, RemoveLink, Restrict |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Validate only, do not persist changes |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--from` |  | `string` |  | Source entity logical name (referenced/parent for 1:N, entity1 for N:N) |
| `--intersect-entity` |  | `string` |  | Schema name of the intersect entity (many-to-many only). Defaults to --name. |
| `--lookup-display-name` |  | `string` |  | Display name of the lookup column (one-to-many only) |
| `--lookup-name` |  | `string` |  | Schema name of the lookup column (one-to-many only) |
| `--name` |  | `string` |  | Schema name for the relationship |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` | `-s` | `string` |  | Solution unique name to add the relationship to |
| `--to` |  | `string` |  | Target entity logical name (referencing/child for 1:N, entity2 for N:N) |
| `--type` |  | `string` |  | Relationship type: one-to-many or many-to-many |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
